content:
Mostly it moved the chemistry, not the dust or the young stars. Compared with `neb_eline_ca_nohe`, [Fe/H] went from −0.160 to −0.190 and [α/Fe] from 0.129 to 0.149. Each shift is about 1.5σ, and both go toward `neb_maskallca` (−0.266, 0.155). These stayed the same within errors: δ_dust (−0.195 vs −0.184), E_bump (2.30 vs 2.47), t_MW (3.38 vs 3.37 Gyr), log M (11.461 vs 11.458), and the 0–30 Myr mass fraction (both about 1e-6, against 1.4e-5 in maskallca).

The [O II] part did almost nothing. That arm never had an [O II] column, so the mask only removed 13 pixels at the blue edge. The [O III] mask removed about 250 pixels and the tied 4959+5007 column, and Hβ kept its free flux. So the drop in young mass and dust from maskallca to nohe comes from the free Balmer-line fluxes, not from fitting [O III].

Sources: `wiki/research/experiments/e-mask-all-ca.md` (Results table) and `results/m1-210210-neb-eline-ca-noo-2026-09-30/comparison.csv`.
